limitations: Initial precipitate is generated abiotically from uranyl acetate within phosphate-bearing medium; no natural ore or isolated pure-mineral feed was tested.
XRD supports the authors phase assignment beyond a formula, but no quantitative phase purity or complete uranium mass balance is given.
Methods glycerol3mL/L and Figure3 glycerol30mmol/L are not equated.
Species node54265 verified; assay strain is not explicitly specified.
No reduction/growth at5/10mM; favorable1/2.5mM loading results cannot be generalized.
Approximate80-90percent refers to U(VI) reduction in source prose/Figure2, not mineral yield or recovered product.
Dissolved uranium pools leave dissolution-mediated pathways possible; no specific redox protein or direct-contact route established.
Analytical duplicate preparations do not clearly establish biological replication. External Slobodkin1997 full medium recipe not obtained; no unsupported recipe additions made.
No new criticality list mapping, field efficacy, industrial deployment or long-term product stability claim.
Other formation/crystallography leads remain uncurated; no abstract-derived measurements imported.
